title: Quinoa Salad with Cauliflower and Chickpeas
subtitle: roasted chickpeas and cauliflower over quinoa
description: A hearty salad of quinoa, roasted cauliflower and crisp roasted chickpeas, tossed in a vinaigrette. It is good served cold or warm.

steps.text: Cook the frozen chickpeas according to the packet instructions, drain and pat dry with a towel. Toss with the roasting seasoning mix until fully coated, spread on a baking tray lined with baking paper and bake for 40 minutes at 180°C. Let cool.

Break the cauliflower into small florets and clean them (soaking in water with 2 tablespoons of vinegar for 10 minutes, then rinsing well and drying, works well). Toss the florets with the seasoning mix and roast for 40 minutes at 200°C, turning halfway.
Rinse the quinoa very well, drain and cook with 1.5 cups of water for 13 minutes in a covered pot. Turn off the heat and leave covered for about 15 minutes. Spread on a tray to cool.

Assemble the salad: combine the quinoa and cauliflower in a bowl and scatter the roasted chickpeas on top. Mix the vinaigrette ingredients and pour over the salad. Sprinkle with parsley and thinly sliced red onion and serve, cold or warm.
